race.comment: The $100,000 Ladbrokes Cleveland Bay. TAMBO'S JUSTICE (13) has a solid record here on his home circuit with seven wins and four placings from 13 attempts and will be high on confidence following that last-start victory here. Only needs some luck from the wide draw to be playing a major role in the finish. DEMON AWARD (2) returned in fine fashion with a strong Rockhampton win and successful jockey Lerena retains the ride. Can go back-to-back to start the campaign. BOLD COMIC (16) was too bad to be true last time out but go on the solid win two back. Worth another chance. YES DREAM (3) is a seven-time winner here who maps nicely for this from gate three. In the mix for some minor money. HELLISH (6) is a bit hit or miss but is capable enough on his day. Keep safe.
